local_entities.label: Apparent second Voyager / temporal reflection
local_entities.notes: Scoped to this work; not treated as a persistent duplicate vessel.

evidence.summary: Torres assaults Carey amid unresolved Starfleet-Maquis integration and engineering command conflict.
Chakotay advocates Torres for chief engineer while Janeway questions discipline and command suitability.
evidence.counterevidence: Carey's experience and Torres's assault complicate a simple merit-only appointment narrative.

evidence.summary: Voyager encounters a quantum singularity and sensor evidence suggesting another trapped vessel.
The crew initially treats the apparent vessel as a separate ship and experiences anomalous communications and duplicated observations.
evidence.counterevidence: Later evidence identifies the apparent vessel as Voyager's temporal reflection.

evidence.summary: Janeway and Torres conclude that the apparent second Voyager is a temporal reflection of their own ship inside the singularity and that observed effects can precede their causes.
Janeway and Torres cooperate to navigate Voyager through the rupture and out of the singularity.
Janeway appoints Torres chief engineer after the crisis; objections and crew-integration tensions remain part of the scene.
The Emergency Medical Hologram describes operational limits tied to the sickbay projection system and his program.
evidence.counterevidence: Self-description establishes the program's reported constraints, not a general theory of holographic personhood.

counterevidence: Her appointment follows documented assault/discipline concerns and competing claims of experience.

neutral_coding.plot_problem: A command-integration dispute unfolds while Voyager becomes trapped in a temporal distortion around a singularity.
neutral_coding.institutions_rules: Janeway and Chakotay negotiate authority, discipline, and personnel legitimacy across Starfleet and Maquis backgrounds.
neutral_coding.identity_epistemics: The apparent second Voyager is preserved first as a contested sensor interpretation and later as a scoped temporal reflection, not globally merged or duplicated.
neutral_coding.counterevidence: Torres's technical competence does not erase assault and discipline concerns; the apparent second ship interpretation is preserved even after supersession.
